user.title: Add a gateway
user.description: The integration itself is already set up - installing it asks nothing and does not get this far. The ELTAKO panel in the sidebar is where gateways, devices and settings are configured; this dialog only adds another gateway.

init.title: ELTAKO settings
init.description: These settings belong to the whole integration - the same ones the 'Settings' page of the ELTAKO web ui offers. A value changed here takes effect immediately and overrides the `general_settings` section of your `configuration.yaml`.

clear_telegram_log.description: Resets the statistics and the live buffer of the EnOcean telegram logger. The telegram log file is not modified.
